records.name: User’s Guide cache repair
records.description: Remove the old Snipers page stuck in User’s Guide. Finds user profiles, backs up recognized caches and preserves other sites.
records.author: Snipers · SQLite · PS5 SDK
records.instructions: Run after jailbreak with ELF loader on 9021. Close User’s Guide and use this page in the regular browser, or send the ELF from a PC. Allow the backup to finish. Close the browser afterward; restart once if the old page remains.

records.name: etaHEN
records.description: Our etaHEN build with Toolbox, services and bundled kstuff. Load directly after jailbreak with the ELF loader running.
records.author: LightningMods / etaHEN and contributors · Snipers port
records.instructions: Complete the jailbreak and start the ELF loader on port 9021 first. This button sends etaHEN directly; it does not run the jailbreak again. Load only if etaHEN is not already running. Wait for its startup notification and Toolbox before loading other payloads.

records.name: ShadowMountPlus
records.description: The standalone build recommended for our etaHEN release. Mount and manage your game backups.
records.author: Drakmor and upstream contributors · Snipers compatibility changes
records.instructions: Wait until etaHEN Toolbox opens normally, then load once. Do not also load standalone kstuff, BackPork or another ShadowMount copy.

records.name: PS5Debug-NG
records.description: Debugger for trainers, memory tools and PS Neighborhood. Listens on port 744.
records.author: Pharaoh2k / OSR · CTN / SiSTR0 lineage
records.instructions: Use one debugger instance. Website loading checks whether it is already running.

records.name: Payload Manager
records.description: Manage payloads from its Media card or browser interface on port 8084.
records.author: itsPLK and contributors
records.instructions: With this host, disable its separate autoload, automatic browser opening and Disc Player closing. The website loader creates safe first-run settings and preserves existing configurations.

records.name: Web File Manager
records.description: Browse and transfer console files through its Media card or HTTP port 8888.
records.author: owendswang and contributors
records.instructions: Optional archive extraction helper is not bundled. Load once per session.

records.name: Homebrew web server
records.description: Launch homebrew and browse files from a browser. HTTP port 8080.
records.author: John Törnblom and contributors
records.instructions: Keep port 8080 available. Load once per session.

records.name: FTP server
records.description: An optional FTP service on port 2121, alongside etaHEN’s FTP on 1337.
records.author: John Törnblom and contributors
records.instructions: Not required if etaHEN FTP already serves your needs. Use port 2121 with this payload.

records.name: NanoDNS
records.description: Local DNS proxy with Sony blocking and User’s Guide routing.
records.author: Drakmor and contributors
records.instructions: Optional. Existing configuration is preserved by our website loader. Active NanoDNS can keep routing requests after you change network DNS; restart without loading it to disable it.

records.name: Host Media shortcut
records.description: Add the Snipers website card to the PS5 Media tab.
records.author: Snipers · etaHEN Toolbox implementation · PS5 SDK
records.instructions: Adds the public website card after jailbreak. Registration may also discover other app folders already staged on your console.
